annotations.title: Get a payment link for a new domain

description: Use this when the person wants a new domain name (e.g. panaderia-ruzafa.es) for their palimpalem website. Requires palimpalem sign-in. Checks that the name is free and returns a payment link on palimpalem.com with the price. On that page the person enters the details of the domain owner (always the person or their business) and pays; the domain is registered after payment. This tool registers nothing and charges nothing.

domain.description: The full domain name with ending, e.g. panaderia-ruzafa.es. Endings: com, es, net, info, org, de, eu.

web.description: Optional when the account has one website. The website the domain is for.
